analysis.reading:
THE ECONOMIC ARGUMENT TRANSMITS WITHOUT SOFTENING. The composed answer carries the inversion at full strength: "money fundamentally OWES ITS VALUE TO MEANING rather than the reverse, making semantic coherence the underlying asset of any true economy", and names The Archive as "foundational repository of semantic coherence that financial/chrematistic systems EXTRACT FROM WITHOUT ACKNOWLEDGING OR REINVESTING."

It also carries BEARING-COST correctly — "maintenance labor shifted onto human creators while platforms capture capitalized output" — which is the claim most likely to be blunted in summary, and is not.

The Google Scholar card is bare and exact: "Constitution of the Semantic Economy. L Sharks. Zenodo." Author, title, repository. No hedge, no persona note, no qualification of standing.

The Constitution of the Semantic Economy is a
theoretical governance framework that establishes
the ontological priority of meaning over capital,
defining value as cumulative coherence and
treating human-generated meaning as the ultimate
creditor of monetary systems. 2
Core Architecture and Concepts
e Debt/Creditor Inversion: Asserts that money
fundamentally owes its value to meaning rather
than the reverse, making semantic coherence
the underlying asset of any true economy. 2
e Semantic Weight: Measures value not by
traditional currency or labor time alone, but by
cumulative, recursively active coherence
generated through cognitive and communicative
labor. 2
e The Archive: Acts as the foundational repository
of semantic coherence that traditional financial
and chrematistic systems extract from without
properly acknowledging or reinvesting in. 2
